name: grove
description: Keeps git worktrees in your workspace, and switches between, creates and sets up worktrees in their own windows.

grove.worktreeBaseDir.markdownDescription: Directory under which new worktrees are created for the **Switch Worktree** command. Absolute, or relative to the repository's main worktree root. Defaults to `.claude/worktrees` inside the repository.

grove.newBranchBase.markdownDescription: Start point for branches created by the **New Branch** action in the Switch Worktree command. The new branch is created at this ref and tracked with Graphite parented on it. Defaults to `master`.

grove.postCreateCommands.markdownDescription: Shell commands run, in order, in each worktree the **Switch Worktree** command creates, after Grove's own setup (checkout, Graphite tracking, `node_modules` clone, Nx root pin) and before its window opens. Defaults to `["mise trust"]`; set `[]` to run nothing. Each runs through `/bin/sh` from the worktree, with `GROVE_WORKTREE_PATH`, `GROVE_BRANCH`, `GROVE_MAIN_ROOT` and, for new branches, `GROVE_BASE_BRANCH` set. Output goes to the Grove log. A failing command is reported but doesn't stop the rest.

grove.directories.markdownDescription: Directories to watch for git worktrees (absolute paths, `~` is expanded). Any direct child folder that is a linked git worktree is added to the workspace automatically, and removed from the workspace when the worktree is deleted.
